name: workbench
description: Five independent explicit skills for change analysis, task planning, verified local execution, repository-aware PR source push, and local project-knowledge curation.

interface.shortDescription: Independent tools for software change analysis and execution.
interface.longDescription: Workbench provides five independently useful, explicitly invoked skills. Investigate changes, plan task profiles, execute isolated tasks with verified local PR-source integration and safe cleanup, prepare repository-appropriate release metadata and push on explicit request, or curate local .codocs knowledge.
capabilities: Per-task model tier and effort selection
Verified local PR-source integration and safe task cleanup
Repository-aware release metadata and explicit source push
defaultPrompt: Use $workbench:shape to investigate this software change.
Use $workbench:prepare to plan tasks, worker profiles, isolation, and verification.
Use $workbench:execute-task to verify this plan, integrate locally, and safely clean task worktrees without pushing.
Use $workbench:pr-push to inspect release conventions, prepare required metadata, and push the confirmed PR source branch.
Use $workbench:memory-update to curate these local project-knowledge topics.
